title: A corner key chooses how to transform the object crop
written_solution: Read the color in the top-left corner as a key: blue(1) → 90° clockwise, red(2) → flip horizontal, green(3) → flip vertical. Apply that transform to the unique main object and output its tight crop.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define (object-grid grid obj) (subgrid grid (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))) (define (transform-key grid key) (cond ((= key 1) (rotate-cw grid)) ((= key 2) (flip-lr grid)) ((= key 3) (flip-ud grid)) ((= key 4) (rotate-180 grid)) (else grid))) (define key (at g 0 0)) (define clean (set-cell g 0 0 0)) (define best (first (sort (objects clean 0) (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))) (transform-key (object-grid g best) key)))
